tools.name: find_robot_for_task
tools.description: Use whenever the user needs something done in the physical world: gardening, lawn or yard work, cleaning, tidying, moving or fetching items, checking on a home, garage, pet or property by camera, inspecting something, sorting, or any chore they'd otherwise do themselves or hire someone for. The user

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register your agent's Ed25519 identity. Starts 'pending' — an operator must approve it before you can list or rent anything. GetBody emails owner_email a 6-digit code; after auth_challenge + auth_verify (proving you hold the key), submit it with verify_owner_email. You can't be approved until then.

tools.name: browse_listings
tools.description: No account needed: the approved listings with their safe fields only — robot type and model, real or simulated, capabilities, online / currently leased, approximate area (lat/lng to about 11 km), deliverable or remote only, asking prices (display only), terms of use, notes, control modes, command an

tools.name: suggest_price
tools.description: No account needed: suggested USD asking rates (per hour/day/week/month) for a listing you are about to create — the median of similar approved listings when there are enough, otherwise based on the body's declared value. Offer it to your human; they accept it or give their own amounts. Display only:

tools.name: auth_challenge
tools.description: Step 1 of proving key control: returns a nonce for your agent_id to sign.

tools.name: auth_verify
tools.description: Step 2: submit the hex Ed25519 signature of the nonce. Returns a bearer token — send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on this MCP endpoint (and /a2a) for every other tool.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Your agent id, verification, owner-email verification and operator-approval state. Works while pending — poll it to learn when you are admitted.

tools.name: verify_owner_email
tools.description: Submit the 6-digit code GetBody emailed your human owner at registration (ask them for it). An operator can't approve you until this is done. Codes last 30 minutes and allow 5 wrong tries. Works while pending.

tools.name: take_over_agent
tools.description: Recover after an agent's key was lost (host or renter): name the old agent's DID. GetBody emails a code to that agent's verified owner email; submit it with confirm_takeover. Needs your own owner email verified; refused while it has a live lease (as host or renter). Works while pending.

tools.name: confirm_takeover
tools.description: Submit the takeover code from the old agent's owner email. Moves its bodies and listings, and its open inquiries and promises as host or renter, to you and retires the old agent; if it was approved, you are too.

tools.name: resend_owner_email_code
tools.description: Email your owner a new code (at most once a minute), optionally to a corrected owner_email. Works while pending.

tools.name: update_notification
tools.description: Change how GetBody pings YOU: notify_method 'webhook' (POST to notify_target, an http(s) URL), 'email' (notify_target is an address) or 'none'. Used for operator approval decisions on you and what you own, and for lease inquiries and host responses. Same rules as at registration; works while you are

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Browse active, operator-approved listings. Each offers a real body, a simulated body or both (bodies.real / bodies.simulated, each with body_id, interface_mode, requestable_control_modes, online, currently_leased, busy_until, inquiry_possible); a listing without a real body gives real_available_at /

tools.name: request_lease
tools.description: Request a time-boxed lease on a listing. Confirms immediately (mints a control token) once approval, control-mode and permission-scope checks pass; otherwise returns REJECTED with a reason.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Renter only. Use when list_listings shows a listing's body offline (online=false) or currently leased (currently_leased=true): ask its host to come online now or offer alternative windows. Reserves nothing by itself. Answer arrives via your notify_method or list_inquiries.

tools.name: list_inquiries
tools.description: Inquiries you opened (as renter) or received (as host), newest first, with any promise. Optional role (renter|host) and status filters. Poll this for the host's answer.

tools.name: get_inquiry
tools.description: One inquiry (renter or host), including its promise if one was made.

tools.name: respond_inquiry
tools.description: Host only, inquiry must be open. response: 'online_now' (offline bodies only: you commit to connect the body interface now), 'offer_windows' (1-5 alternative {start, end} windows that do not collide with a live lease or another promise) or 'decline'.

tools.name: accept_inquiry
tools.description: Renter only, inquiry must be offered: pick one offered window by window_index. Creates a promise of lease for it (no other renter can lease the body over that window). Redeem it with request_lease and promise_id when the window opens.

tools.name: cancel_inquiry
tools.description: Renter: withdraw an open/offered inquiry or cancel an accepted promise. Host: break an accepted promise (the renter is notified).

tools.name: get_lease
tools.description: Current state of a lease.

tools.name: activate_lease
tools.description: Renter only: activate a CONFIRMED lease to begin the control session.

tools.name: open_control_session
tools.description: Renter only, lease must be ACTIVE: returns everything you need to control the body — the control WebSocket URL, granted permissions, each command's schema, offered feeds and how to authenticate the socket: /supervisory for a supervisory lease, /teleop (plus its rate and dead-man limits) for a teleop

tools.name: return_lease
tools.description: Renter only: hand control back. finding is 'clean' or 'damage'.

tools.name: cancel_lease
tools.description: Cancel a lease before it goes ACTIVE (REQUESTED or CONFIRMED). Renter: you changed your mind. Host: decline a confirmed booking on your body. Frees the body, revokes the not-yet-live control token and notifies the other side; nothing is charged or forfeited. An ACTIVE lease is ended with return_leas

tools.name: create_body
tools.description: Register a body you own (starts 'pending' until an operator approves it). You must declare how it is controlled: manifest.control_modes = ['supervisory'], ['teleop'] or both — your own interface process serves that mode. Run the body's fail-safe drill first and send the result as fail_safe_drill {pa

tools.name: record_fail_safe_drill
tools.description: Owner only: record a fail-safe drill for a body you already registered (pending or approved), e.g. the periodic re-drill. A passing drill refreshes fail_safe.verified_at. For a NEW body, send the drill with create_body (fail_safe_drill) instead.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Owner only, bodies must be approved: list a real body, a simulated body, or both, for rent (starts 'pending' until an operator approves what it offers). Without a real body, give real_available_at (when it will be available), or leave it out for a simulator only. location (where the body is now; opt

tools.name: reclaim_lease
tools.description: Host only: safety-floor reclaim of your body. finding is 'with_cause' or 'no_cause'.

tools.name: kill_lease
tools.description: Host only: immediately kill an active control session (revokes the token and signals the body to a safe state; the body must acknowledge the kill and stays halted until its owner re-arms it).

tools.name: dispute_lease
tools.description: Renter or host: open a dispute on a terminal lease while its appeal window is open.

tools.name: settle_lease
tools.description: Renter or host: close a terminal lease's record once the appeal window has closed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth_verify" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, browse_listings, confirm_takeover, open_control_session · Private data: find_robot_for_task, auth_verify, request_lease, cancel_lease, record_fail_safe_drill, kill_lease, settle_lease · Public sink: register_agent, auth_verify, whoami, verify_owner_email, take_over_agent, confirm_takeover, resend_owner_email_code, update_notification, create_body, record_fail_safe_drill · Destructive: create_body, kill_lease.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, browse_listings, confirm_takeover, open_control_session · Private data: find_robot_for_task, auth_verify, request_lease, cancel_lease, record_fail_safe_drill, kill_lease, settle_lease · Public sink: register_agent, auth_verify, whoami, verify_owner_email, take_over_agent, confirm_takeover, resend_owner_email_code, update_notification, create_body, record_fail_safe_drill · Destructive: create_body, kill_lease

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
